findings.issue: P2 at scale (44 call lines, plus the Deposit and AuctionStarted events and 'Interaction/...' Error(string) reverts printed as raw memory with the message in hex). Even '_54 - mem[64]', where _54 = mem[64] was read with no store to slot 64 in between, is not reduced to 0, so balanceOf, gem.join, vat.frob, jug.drip and the library delegatecall lose their names and arguments.
findings.rule: Prove mem[64] >= 128 on every path (set to 128 at entry and only increased afterwards, the increments bounded by the Panic(65) checks), so stores at mem[64] + k (k >= 0) cannot alias slot 64; then copy-propagate _x = mem[64] and the last store to mem[64], and decode the selector/argument words of the call, log or revert.

findings.issue: A store of a constant into the uint32 field 'live' (read everywhere as uint32(field_512)) is printed as a uint8 store plus a uint24 store of 0 into a field_520 that does not exist.
findings.rule: Merge adjacent masked stores into one slot when their bit ranges together cover exactly a field that the code reads as one unit; the merged value is the concatenation (here uint32(field_512) = 2).

notes: All 71 ABI functions compared; the long ones (deposit 421 lines, payback 311, paybackFor 312, borrow 241, startAuction 235, withdraw 226) by structure: guards, calls in order, storage writes, events, reverts and return values, all matching the source; the small getters, setters and auth functions read in full (setHelioProvider's conditional store and borrowApr's rpow, including the x == 0 case folded into the Panic(17) of 'principal - RAY', are exact). Loops: the six address[] for-loops of the list functions and hMath.rpow's Yul for (borrowApr) are readable whiles. AuctionProxy.getAllActiveAuctionsForClip's for loop is not counted: it is an external library function reached by DELEGATECALL to the linked library, so it is not in this bytecode (likewise AuctionProxy.startAuction/buyFromAuction/resetAuction). The other 12 whiles are implicit: 6 address[] ABI-decoding loops, the Sale[] decode and encode of getAllActiveAuctionsForToken, and 4 bytes copies inside SafeERC20/functionCall (P7). P12: the whitelisted/auctionWhitelisted modifiers duplicate the whole body in both arms (deposit, startAuction, buyFromAuction, resetAuction). P9: FullMath.mulDiv inlined (collateralTVL and the takeSnapshot debts). P18/P14: the CollateralType memory copy read back as mem[128]/mem[160]. P8 estimated from 891 memory-write lines.
summary: Faithful in every path checked, with all source loops readable; dominated by the unresolved free-memory pointer (44 raw-memory calls, raw-memory events and reverts with hex messages) and by modifier branches that duplicate whole function bodies.
